context: Integration test job runs on a self-hosted runner. A teammate split teardown into two steps and added log collection for easier debugging.
explanation: "Stop containers" correctly keeps `if: always()`, but the new "Remove test volumes" step — the one that actually frees disk and clears stale DB state — has no `if: always()`. When the test step fails (the case you most need cleanup for), this step is skipped, so volumes and data from the failed run persist on the self-hosted runner and can leak into the next job's results. Fix: add `if: always()` to the volume-removal step too.
